deviations_from_paper.explanation: Position-weighted 4-gram recall over lowercased, whitespace-stripped controlled GT strings; exact GT string recovery is also 1.0. Internal text-layer character coverage is reported separately.
Pairwise concordance over all 28 controlled GT pairs after conservative continuation-block merging; no figure resource is required as evidence.
All nine ruled-table cells match case-sensitively after whitespace removal. The same run measures PyMuPDF at 5/9 = 0.5556 and pdfplumber at 9/9 = 1.0.
Fraction of geometric top/bottom-band characters emitted as non-marginal content. Both the controlled page and the first six real-paper pages report 0.0.

reference_value.rule: Skill continuity > naive continuity, Skill concordance >= naive concordance, and Skill concordance >= 0.99

deviations_from_paper.explanation: Both continuity sequences contain the identical 14 raw text lines; only the ordering differs. Skill continuity is 0.8462 versus 0.0769 for pure-y sorting.

envelope.unit: absent(0)/present(1); absence is detected as unreadable

failure_modes.condition: image-only scanned page without a text layer
failure_modes.symptom: The parser returns zero text blocks and verify.py reports unreadable_pages=[1]; OCR remains necessary.

failure_modes.condition: password-encrypted PDF when empty-password authentication fails
failure_modes.symptom: The parser reports a clear encryption error and the CLI exits with code 2 instead of emitting fabricated text.
